## Recovered Scientific Decisions Applied To The Proposed Packet

These are prior owner decisions, not new Stage A derivations. Their exact
sources and digests are in [`PRIOR_WORK.md`](PRIOR_WORK.md).

| Decision | Recovered approved substance |
| --- | --- |
| `SCI-MAP-002-D003-SUPPORT-001` | Retain fully populated square cache support and dual-use `r_max`; do not infer a strict radial cutoff. |
| `SCI-MAP-002-D003-SUBPIXEL-001` | Retain phase-quantized point sampling; do not reinterpret it as pixel-area integration. |
| `SCI-MAP-002-D003-CONDITIONING-001` | Use finite-positive `Q` plus dimensionless cancellation ratio and a summation-dependent floating-point bound; no unit-bearing `C`/`Q` floor. |
| `SCI-MAP-002-D003-ADMISSION-001` | Require stable array identity and finite strictly positive physical parameters; preserve finite signed lobes; fail on non-finite coefficient state. |
| `SCI-MAP-002-D003-MASK-001` | Keep formal-support validity distinct from temporal support and empirical policy; empirical policy may downgrade but never promote. |
| `SCI-MAP-002-D003-COVERAGE-001` | Define `sum(c^2/f_s)` seconds as coefficient-squared effective integration time, not exposure, hits, precision, or validity. |
| `SCI-MAP-002-D003-KERNEL-001` | Define `K/C` as the processing-filtered source-template response projected through JINC with exact operator and parent identity. |
| `SCI-MAP-002-D003-PROVENANCE-001` | Require compact atomic requested/effective/resolved/realized provenance and product joins; required failure suppresses success. |

## Stage A Boundary Abstraction

| Decision | Stage A treatment |
| --- | --- |
| `JINC-SCOPE-D001` | Reuse the frozen independent core once, under the proposed supersession cover; do not repeat its signed-estimator derivation. |
| `JINC-SCOPE-D002` | Abstract the accepted destination-ownership work to one representation-independent invariant: unique complete destination identity is resolved before mutation or the operation fails atomically. Raw repair/audit/test evidence remains excluded. |
| `JINC-SCOPE-D003` | Treat the recovered observation-level estimator as in scope. Do not import an observation-coadd rule until the owner explicitly approves one. |
| `JINC-SCOPE-D004` | Keep inverse-variance, covariance, and significance meaning conditional on an exact upstream coefficient family and its evidence. |
| `JINC-SCOPE-D005` | Treat the unnamed historical JINC memo underlying the March alignment note as unavailable. Do not reconstruct its contents from implementation or memory. |
| `JINC-SCOPE-D006` | The owner later supplied an authoritative generic-method reference, `Schloerb_JINC_memo_v1.1.pdf`, SHA-256 `835fb02e842c9109c2c7ad3f03288882dfac283e63bfcd0f818c7d5379e7e5cd`. It closes the generic analytic-method gap without being asserted byte-identical to the unnamed historical memo; D005 therefore continues to govern that unidentified source. |
| `JINC-SCOPE-D007` | Normalize the memo's `2 jinc_memo(x)` to the package peak-normalized `J(x)=2J_1(x)/x`, preserving Equation 9 exactly as `J(2 pi r'/a) exp[-(2r'/b)^c] J(3.831706 r'/RMAX)`. Apply square-support and point-phase owner supersessions. |
| `JINC-SCOPE-D008` | Before ODQ-102B, keep TolTEC `a1100`/`a1400`/`a2000` effective radial scales and parameter values/provenance unresolved. A three-band optimum-parameter derivation is a separate downstream scientific tranche. |
| `JINC-SCOPE-D009` | ODQ-102B preserves `r'_a=r/s_a` with explicit array-associated angular `s_a`, makes the Schloerb `s=lambda/D` convention precedent rather than TolTEC authorization, permits array association for all scientifically appropriate shape/extent parameters, and types every TolTEC numerical route unavailable absent a separately authorized parameter set. Inherited `lambda_a/(45 m)`, shape, and mode `r_max` values remain evidence only; no hidden default or physical interpretation of `45 m` is authorized. |
| `JINC-SCOPE-D010` | ODQ-103 binds AST's authoritative coordinate and parent-sample association to the same processed realization entering JINC, while leaving representation mechanics to engineering. JINC owns `SCI-JINC:jinc_map_contribution@1`, local geometry/support/signed coefficient, sample-admission versus sample-pixel support, coupled-accumulator identity and JINC-local causes. No MAP admission/validity inheritance, inferred association fallback, producer JINC-usability decision, or new per-contribution provenance system is admitted. |

`JINC-SCOPE-D001--D010` are proposed packet boundary statements and become
author inputs only if the scientific owner approves the exact Scope Brief and
manifest.
